title: The Forgotten Classroom
summary: Attacked by elite Hunter Agent Jun-Hyuk, Ha-Jun retreats into a hidden 1920s underground warlock laboratory beneath Saint Mirren. There, he discovers a classified journal containing his elder brother Tae-Jun's handwriting—exposing the Hunter Bureau's dark conspiracy and the location of the third relic.

panels.shot: dust clearing white coat hunter reveal
panels.action: Dust clears at the shattered entrance; Agent Jun-Hyuk in a pristine white trench coat with silver cross lapels twirls twin humming silver blades.
panels.prose_en: Dust clears at the shattered entrance; Agent Jun-Hyuk in a pristine white trench coat with silver cross lapels twirls twin humming silver blades.
panels.prose_hi: Toote hue pravesh dwar par dhul saaf ho jaati hai; silver cross lapls ke saath ek prachin safed trench coat mein agent jun-hyuk twin gungunate hue silver blade ghumate han.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk smirks coldly: 'Kal ek Grade-C beast ko maar kar hero samajh rahe ho? Asli shikariyon se ab tak paala nahi pada tumhara.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Asli shikariyon se ab tak paala nahi pada tumhara.

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk smirks coldly: 'Kal ek Grade-C beast ko maar kar hero samajh rahe ho? Asli shikariyon se ab tak paala nahi pada tumhara.'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk thande swar mein muskurata hai: 'kal ek gred-si janwar ko maar kar hero samajh rahe ho? asli shikariyon se ab tak pala nahin pada tumhara.'.

panels.shot: dual stance blood dagger and gauntlet
panels.action: Ha-Jun sinks into a low combat stance: Crystalline gauntlet raised to guard his chest, freshly forged crimson blood dagger held in reverse grip.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Iski speed aam insaan se kahin zyada hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sinks into a low combat stance: Crystalline gauntlet raised to guard his chest, freshly forged crimson blood dagger held in reverse grip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek kam ladaku rukh mein doob jata hai: uski chhati ki raksha ke liye crystaliy gauntlet uthaya jata hai, taja jalidar laal khoon khanjar ko reverse grip mein rakha jata hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk vanishes in a zig-zag blur of silver lightning, sparks scorching the basalt floor tiles.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk vanishes in a zig-zag blur of silver lightning, sparks scorching the basalt floor tiles.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk chandi ki bijli ke tedhe-medhe dhundhlepan mein gayab ho jata hai, chingari basalt farsh ki tailon ko jhulsa deti hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk materializes in front of Ha-Jun, snapping both silver blades in a lethal scissor strike aimed at his throat.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk materializes in front of Ha-Jun, snapping both silver blades in a lethal scissor strike aimed at his throat.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk Ha-Jun ke samne prakat hota hai, aur uske gale par ghatak kainchi se war karke chandi ki donon bladen tod deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun brings his crystalline gauntlet up: The twin silver blades slam into the purple crystal, detonating in a blinding shower of sparks.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun brings his crystalline gauntlet up: The twin silver blades slam into the purple crystal, detonating in a blinding shower of sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne crystaliy hathiyar ko upar lata hai: judwan chandi ke blade baingani crystal mein takrate han, jisse chingari ki andhadhundh bauchhar mein visfot ho jata hai.

panels.shot: holy silver burning acid hiss macro
panels.action: The silver blades hiss against demonic mana, radiating white holy fire that scorches Ha-Jun's knuckles like corrosive acid.
panels.prose_en: The silver blades hiss against demonic mana, radiating white holy fire that scorches Ha-Jun's knuckles like corrosive acid.
panels.prose_hi: Chandi ke blade shaitani demonic man ke khilaf fusfusate han, jisse safed pavitra aag nikalti hai jo sanksharak acid ki tarah Ha-Jun ke por ko jhulsa deti hai.

panels.action: Kuro: 'Holy Silver metallurgy! Yeh Bureau ke anti-demon hathiyar hain! Direct contact se bacho!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Holy silver hai! Chhoone mat do!

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'Holy Silver metallurgy! Yeh Bureau ke anti-demon hathiyar hain! Direct contact se bacho!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'pavitra rajat dhatukarm! yeh bureau ke rakshas virodhi hathiyare han! sidhe sampark se bacho!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pivots on his heel, sweeping his blood dagger low in a razor arc, forcing Jun-Hyuk into an emergency backflip.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pivots on his heel, sweeping his blood dagger low in a razor arc, forcing Jun-Hyuk into an emergency backflip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni edi par ghumaya, apne khoon ke khanjar ko ek razor arc mein neeche ghumaya, jisse jun-hyuk ko ek aapatkalin backflip mein majboor hona pada.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk lands 15 feet away on one knee, instantly drawing a silver flash-dart from his tactical chest rig.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk lands 15 feet away on one knee, instantly drawing a silver flash-dart from his tactical chest rig.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ek ghutne ke bal 15 feet door utarta hai aur turant apne samrik chest rig se ek chandi ka flash-dart khinchta hai.

panels.action: The dart strikes the basalt floor at Ha-Jun's feet, detonating into a blinding magnesium flash and 160-decibel concussive sonic blast.
panels.prose_en: The dart strikes the basalt floor at Ha-Jun's feet, detonating into a blinding magnesium flash and 160-decibel concussive sonic blast.
panels.prose_hi: Dart Ha-Jun ke pairon par basalt farsh se takrata hai, jisse ek chakachaundh magnesium flash aur 160-desibal dhwanik visfot hota hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's vision whites out completely, ears screaming with high-pitched feedback as he stumbles backward.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's vision whites out completely, ears screaming with high-pitched feedback as he stumbles backward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki drishti puri tarah se dhundhli ho jaati hai, jaise hi wah peeche ki or ladkhadata hai, kaan unchi-unchi pratikriya se chillate han.

panels.shot: hunter lunging through smoke for the kill
panels.action: Jun-Hyuk lunges through the smoke cloud, his silver blade thrusting forward in a straight killing thrust toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk lunges through the smoke cloud, his silver blade thrusting forward in a straight killing thrust toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk dhuen ke badal ke beech se nikalta hai, uska chandi ka blade Ha-Jun ki chhati ki or sidha maarta hua aage badhta hai.

panels.action: Kuro dive-bombs from the darkness, raking razor-sharp demonic talons across Jun-Hyuk's goggles in an explosion of purple sparks.
panels.prose_en: Kuro dive-bombs from the darkness, raking razor-sharp demonic talons across Jun-Hyuk's goggles in an explosion of purple sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro andhere se gota lagata hai, baingani chingari ke visfot mein jun-hyuk ke chashme par ustra-tej shaitani demonic panje bikherta hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk stumbles, blood trickling from his nose as his tactical goggles shatter, slashing blindly at the fluttering bird.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk stumbles, blood trickling from his nose as his tactical goggles shatter, slashing blindly at the fluttering bird.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ladkhadata hai, uski naak se khoon bahane lagta hai aur uska samrik chashma toot jata hai, jo fadfadate pakshi par andhadhundh war karta hai.

panels.action: Regaining his footing, Ha-Jun grabs Kuro and dives headfirst into the open trapdoor beneath the obsidian altar.
panels.prose_en: Regaining his footing, Ha-Jun grabs Kuro and dives headfirst into the open trapdoor beneath the obsidian altar.
panels.prose_hi: Apne pair jamate hue, Ha-Jun Kuro ko pakad leta hai aur obsidian vedi ke neeche khule jaal mein gota lagata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slides down a steep, curved stone chute at breakneck speed, friction kicking up clouds of ancient dust.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides down a steep, curved stone chute at breakneck speed, friction kicking up clouds of ancient dust.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khatarnak gati se ek khadi, ghumavdar patthar ki dhalaan se neeche fisalta hai, gharshan ke karan prachin dhul ke badal uchalte han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun crashes in a tumble onto a creaking, decaying wooden parquet floor, dusting off his uniform as he looks up.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun crashes in a tumble onto a creaking, decaying wooden parquet floor, dusting off his uniform as he looks up.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek charamrate, sadte hue lakdi ke lakdi ke farsh par gir jata hai, jaise hi wah upar dekhta hai, uski vardi dhul-dhusrit ho jaati hai.

panels.action: Wide panoramic reveal: An enormous, abandoned 1920s underground medical lecture hall; curved mahogany amphitheater benches rise in tiers.

dialogue.text: Zameen ke sau foot neeche... ek sadi purani classroom.

panels.prose_en: Wide panoramic reveal: An enormous, abandoned 1920s underground medical lecture hall; curved mahogany amphitheater benches rise in tiers.
panels.prose_hi: Vyapak manoram drishya: ek vishal, parityakt 1920 ke dashak ka bhumigat chikitsa vyakhyan kaksh; ghumavdar mahogani emphitheater bench staron mein badhti han.

panels.action: A colossal green slate blackboard covered in intricate demonic summoning equations, pentagrams, and Latin anatomical notes.

dialogue.text: Saint Mirren sirf ek university nahi thi...

panels.prose_en: A colossal green slate blackboard covered in intricate demonic summoning equations, pentagrams, and Latin anatomical notes.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal hara slate blackboard jatil shaitani demonic aahvaan samikarnon, pentagram aur latin sharirik notes se dhaka hua hai.

panels.action: Glass specimen jars line the mahogany cabinets: Preserved demon claws, glowing violet organs, and horned skulls suspended in amber fluid.
panels.prose_en: Glass specimen jars line the mahogany cabinets: Preserved demon claws, glowing violet organs, and horned skulls suspended in amber fluid.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ke namune ke jar mahogani almariyan panktibaddh han: sanrakshit danav panje, chamakte baingani ang, aur amber taral padarth mein nilambit seeng wali khopri.

panels.action: Kuro perches on a marble dissecting table in the center: 'Saint Mirren ke founders warlock the jo Relics par experiment karte the.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yahan insaan aur shaitan ke khoon ko milaya jaata tha.

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on a marble dissecting table in the center: 'Saint Mirren ke founders warlock the jo Relics par experiment karte the.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro kendra mein ek sangmarmar ki vichchhedan mej par baitha hai: 'sent miren ke sansthapak jo avsheshon par prayog karte the.'

panels.action: Resting on the marble table is a thick, leather-bound researcher journal stamped with a faded red wax seal of the University crest.
panels.prose_en: Resting on the marble table is a thick, leather-bound researcher journal stamped with a faded red wax seal of the University crest.
panels.prose_hi: Sangmarmar ki mej par ek moti, chamde se bandhi shodhkarta patrika hai jis par vishwavidyalaya shikhar ki fiki lal mom ki muhar lagi hui hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun opens the brittle yellowed pages: The sharp, familiar cursive handwriting on the first page makes his heart stop.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh handwriting... yeh toh bhaiya ki handwriting hai!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun opens the brittle yellowed pages: The sharp, familiar cursive handwriting on the first page makes his heart stop.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bhangur peele pannon ko kholta hai: pehle prishth par tej, parichit ghasit likhawat uske dil ko rok deti hai.

panels.action: Close-up on the page: 'Bureau ne humein dhokha diya. Wo insaano ko bachane ke liye nahi, balki ek immortal fauj banane ke liye Relics chura rahe hain.'

dialogue.text: 'Bureau immortal army banane ke liye Relics chura raha hai.'

panels.prose_en: Balki ek immortal fauj banane ke liye Relics chura rahe hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Balki ek amar fauj banane ke liye avashesh chura rahe han.'

panels.action: Tae-Jun's note: 'Ha-Jun, agar tum yeh padh rahe ho... toh agla relic, Bone of the Forgotten, East Observatory ke neeche chupa hai.'

dialogue.text: 'Agla relic East Observatory ke neeche hai.'

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's note: 'Ha-Jun, agar tum yeh padh rahe ho... toh agla relic, Bone of the Forgotten, East Observatory ke neeche chupa hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ka not: 'Ha-Jun, agar tum yeh padh rahe ho... to agla avshesh, bone off the forgoton, east observatory ke neeche chhupa hai.'

panels.action: A single warm tear falls from Ha-Jun's eye, soaking into the paper: 'Bhaiya yahan aaye the... unhone yeh sab mere liye chhoda.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Unhone yeh sab mere liye chhoda tha...

panels.prose_en: A single warm tear falls from Ha-Jun's eye, soaking into the paper: 'Bhaiya yahan aaye the... unhone yeh sab mere liye chhoda.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankh se ek garm aansu girta hai, jo kagaj mein sama jata hai: 'Bhaiya yahan aaye the... unhen yeh sab mere liye chhoda.'

panels.action: Above the ceiling, heavy combat boot footsteps slide down the stone chute: Jun-Hyuk has arrived at the threshold.
panels.prose_en: Above the ceiling, heavy combat boot footsteps slide down the stone chute: Jun-Hyuk has arrived at the threshold.
panels.prose_hi: Chhat ke upar, bhari combat boot ke padchaap patthar ki dhalaan se neeche fisalte han: jun-hyuk dahalij par aa gaya hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun carefully tucks the journal inside his navy blazer; all tears and hesitation disappear, replaced by ice-cold predator resolve.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun carefully tucks the journal inside his navy blazer; all tears and hesitation disappear, replaced by ice-cold predator resolve.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne savdhani se journal ko apne navy blazer ke andar chhipa liya; sare aansu aur jhijhak gayab ho jaate han, unki jagah barf-thanda shikari sankalp le leta hai.

panels.shot: igniting blood blade in amphitheater cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands at the base of the amphitheater, extending his blood dagger as crimson hellfire ignites along the blade: 'Wo mujhe maarne aaya hai. Dekhte hain wo zinda wapas jaa paata hai ya nahi.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wo mujhe maarne aaya hai. Ab uski baari hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands at the base of the amphitheater, extending his blood dagger as crimson hellfire ignites along the blade: 'Wo mujhe maarne aaya hai. Dekhte hain wo zinda wapas jaa paata hai ya nahi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun emphitheater ke aadhar par khada hai, apne khoon ke khanjar ko faila raha hai jaise ki gahre lal rang ki narkankaal blade ke saath prajvalit ho rahi hai: 'vo mujhe maarne aaya hai. dekhte hain woh jinda wapas ja pata hai ya nahin.'
